text:
amy (Support): Customer (acct: 4582 / org: acme-inc) reported an invoice spike — billed ~1.8M tokens vs served ~1.2M for 2024-03-21. They use continuous coalescing batcher + prefix KV cache. Invoice INV-20240322-9876. Can eng triage? :eyes:

devon (Infra): Can do. Need sample request ids and exact time window + their runtime config (batching_window_ms, continuous_batcher_enabled).

amy (Support): Time window: 2024-03-21T00:00:00Z -> 2024-03-22T00:00:00Z. Sample req ids: req_az3f, req_gk9b. Config they sent: `continuous_batcher: true`, `coalesce_window_ms: 200`, `prefix_kv_cache: enabled`, `cache_ttl_s: 3600`.

sasha (Billing): Pulled billing logs: metered_tokens_total = 1,800,432; served_tokens_total = 1,200,130 for acct 4582 in window. Delta ~600k aligns with coalescing periods in our timeline. Suspect double-counting when batches are coalesced + prefix cache hits counted separately.

kevin (SRE): Attaching a short trace snippet for req_az3f from runtime logs: 

```
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] REQ req_az3f START
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] BATCH_COALESCE id=cb-112 tokens_served=50 tokens_billed=75 window_ms=200
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] KV_CACHE prefix_hit=true prefix_key=("user:4582:pref")
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] METER_INC account=4582 inc=75 source=coalescer
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] METER_INC account=4582 inc=25 source=kv-cache
[2024-03-21T12:01:05Z] REQ req_az3f DONE served=50 billed=100
```

kevin (SRE): From that snippet you can see both the coalescer and the kv-cache emitted meter increments for overlapping tokens. That explains the ~2x amplification during heavy coalescing windows.

amy (Support): So the coalescer bills the total, and then cache path bills again for prefix hits? Shouldn't cache hits be counted only as served, not billed?

devon (Infra): Right — expected behaviour: coalescer emits a single metering event with a de-dup flag for downstream cache emissions. Bug: coalescer currently doesn't set skip-cache-meter flag when it accounts for tokens, so downstream components emit additional METER_INC.

sasha (Billing): Immediate mitigation: disable continuous coalescing for this account while we patch. Workaround admin API call: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/accounts/4582/config \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
 -d '{"continuous_batcher_enabled": false}'
```

devon (Infra): Also recommended PromQL queries to reconcile quickly: 
`sum(increase(metered_tokens_total{account="4582"}[1d])) - sum(increase(served_tokens_total{account="4582"}[1d]))` 
and per-component: `sum by(component) (increase(metered_tokens_total{account="4582"}[1d]))` — will show which component (coalescer vs kv-cache) is contributing.

kevin (SRE): I'll add a canary patch that sets `skip_cache_meter=true` in the coalescer event and add unit+integration tests to prevent regression. Planning deploy to canary tomorrow AM.

sasha (Billing): I'll flag the invoice for manual review and create a short-term credit for the customer for the suspicious window. Will follow up with accounting. :white_check_mark:

amy (Support): I've informed the customer, applied the admin config to disable coalescing, and asked them to confirm next billing window. Creating internal bug: RINF-1258 (coalescer double-metering on prefix hits).

metering-bot: Observability note: created alert `metering.delta.large` for acct=4582 when billed-served > 100k over 1d.

devon (Infra): Follow-ups: 1) hotfix to coalescer to include skip flag, 2) add integration test covering coalescer+kv-cache path, 3) postmortem + fix in billing reconciliation script to detect overlapping meter events. I'll own the PR.

amy (Support): Thanks team — I'll keep the ticket open until patch is in prod and invoice is settled.

sasha (Billing): Will post final adjustment entry once root cause confirmed.

kevin (SRE): Putting the canary change into the 09:00 UTC deploy; will report results in this thread.

amy (Support): Thanks everyone.
